sources.excerpt: Published on April 10, 2026 VFE Pedals distortion fuzz overdrive pedal Information The VFE Pedals Killer Rabbit Stereo is a stereo-capable multi-drive effects pedal that combines overdrive, distortion, and fuzz circuits within a configurable dual-channel signal path. It integrates four independent drive circuits: two overdrive or boost stages derived from the Dragon overdrive, a distortion circuit based on the Alpha Dog, and a fuzz circuit derived from the Fiery Red Horse. Each circuit is independently controllable and footswitchable, and can be assigned to either the left or right side of the stereo field, allowing flexible routing for stereo pedalboard setups or dual-amp configurations. The signal path begins with an FET op amp input buffer featuring internal impedance trimmers, which feeds multiple routing options. The two overdrive or boost circuits are positioned first in the chain and can be configured independently across the stereo channels, stacked together on one side, or used asymmetrically with one side bypassed. The distortion and fuzz circuits follow and operate in parallel, with selectable placement across the stereo field. A dry blend control mixes the buffered clean signal back into the output, while a master volume sets the final level. The overdrive or boost sections incorporate pre- and post-gain filtering, including adjustable high-pass and low-pass filters with selectable slope characteristics. The fuzz and distortion sections provide extensive tone-shaping and clipping options, including variable gain staging, selectable clipping types, and power scaling for the fuzz circuit. The distortion circuit includes both hard and soft clipping controls with selectable diode behaviors and a center position that removes clipping from each stage. The fuzz circuit allows adjustment of gain stages and supply voltage behavior. The pedal supports both mono and stereo operation depending on cable configuration, including TRS-based stereo connections. Controls Overdrive Stack : Routes one overdrive circuit into the other on a selected side. Bypass ODL/ODR : Places either the left or right overdrive circuit in permanent bypass. Footswitch : Engages or bypasses the active overdrive configuration. Overdrive Left Gain : Sets the gain level of the overdrive or boost circuit. Level : Controls the output level feeding the subsequent stages. HPF : Adjusts the cutoff frequency of a pre-gain high-pass filter. LPF : Adjusts the cutoff frequency of a post-gain low-pass filter. 6 dB / 12 dB : Selects the slope of the HPF and LPF filters. Overdrive Right Gain : Sets the gain level of the overdrive or boost circuit. Level : Controls the output level feeding the subsequent stages. HPF : Adjusts the cutoff frequency of a pre-gain high-pass filter. LPF : Adjusts the cutoff frequency of a post-gain low-pass filter. 6 dB / 12 dB : Selects the slope of the HPF and LPF filters. Fuzz Tone : Blends between bass and treble emphasis. Power : Adjusts the supply voltage to the fuzz gain stages. Gain : Sets the gain level of the fuzz circuit. Level : Controls the output level in the final mix. Mids : Adjusts midrange response from scooped to boosted. L/R : Assigns the fuzz to the left or right channel. Stages : Selects the number of fuzz gain stages. Footswitch : Engages or bypasses the fuzz circuit. Distortion Gain : Sets the gain level of the distortion circuit. Level : Controls the output level in the final mix. L/R : Assigns the distortion to the left or right channel. Hard : Continuously adjusts the hard clipping configuration, with a center position that removes hard clipping. Soft : Continuously adjusts the soft clipping configuration, with a center position that removes soft clipping. Slew : Alters the slew rate of the op amp in the distortion stage. Fat : Adjusts low-frequency response of the gain stage. Filter : Sets the cutoff frequency of a post-gain low-pass filter. Footswitch : Engages or bypasses the distortion circuit. Global Dry : Blends the clean buffered signal into the output mix. Master : Sets the overall output volume. Connections Input/Output : Mono or stereo operation via standard 6.35 mm (1/4 inch) cables TRS Support : Stereo operation via TRS cables for compatible equipment Technical Specifications Filter Slopes : 6 dB/octave or 12 dB/octave selectable Input Stage : FET op amp buffer with internal impedance trimpots Op Amp (Distortion Stage) : LM308 Highlights Stereo multi-drive pedal with configurable left and right signal routing Four independent circuits: dual overdrive or boost, distortion, and fuzz Independent controls and footswitches for each effect section Parallel fuzz and distortion stages with channel assignment control Adjustable pre- and post-gain filtering with selectable slopes Distortion section with continuous hard and soft clipping controls Fuzz section with variable gain stages and power scaling control Dry blend and master output controls for precise mix integration Mono and stereo compatibility including TRS-based connections Reviews myFXDB user reviews No reviews yet + Add your review Links VFE Custom VFE Pedals VFE Pedals Killer Rabbit stereo distortion machine VFE Pedals Killer Rabbit stereo distortion machine v(e) Design (new company) Where to find one?
